SET @prov_c='%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_paliative_kancha1 (
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  t1 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  r1 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  t2 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  r2 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  t3 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  r3 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  tc int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  rc int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  ti int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  ri int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  tf int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  rf int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  tn int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  rn int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  tj int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  rj int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  ti5 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  ri5 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  tr int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  rr int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
	cvisit int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
	cvisit_pharm int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_paliative_kancha1  WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);
INSERT IGNORE INTO s_paliative_kancha1  
(
SELECT 
@id,h.hoscode,CONCAT(h.provcode,h.distcode,h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 14,t.cid,NULL)) t1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 14 AND t.count_visit_pharma >0,t.cid,NULL)) r1

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 14 AND t.c=1,t.cid,NULL)) t2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 14 AND t.c=1 AND t.count_visit_pharma >0,t.cid,NULL)) r2

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) >=15,t.cid,NULL)) t3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) >=15 AND t.count_visit_pharma >0,t.cid,NULL)) r3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) >=15 AND t.c in(1),t.cid,NULL)) tc
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) >=15 AND t.c in(1) AND t.count_visit_pharma >0,t.cid,NULL)) rc
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) >=15 AND t.i in(1),t.cid,NULL)) ti
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) >=15 AND t.i in(1) AND t.count_visit_pharma >0,t.cid,NULL)) ri
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) >=15 AND t.f in(1),t.cid,NULL)) tf
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) >=15 AND t.f in(1) AND t.count_visit_pharma >0,t.cid,NULL)) rf
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) >=15 AND t.n in(1),t.cid,NULL)) tn
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) >=15 AND t.n in(1) AND t.count_visit_pharma >0,t.cid,NULL)) rn
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) >=15 AND t.j in(1),t.cid,NULL)) tj
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) >=15 AND t.j in(1) AND t.count_visit_pharma >0,t.cid,NULL)) rj
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) >=15 AND t.i5 in(1),t.cid,NULL)) ti5
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) >=15 AND t.i5 in(1) AND t.count_visit_pharma >0,t.cid,NULL)) ri5
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) >=15 AND t.r in(1),t.cid,NULL)) tr
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.min_date) >=15 AND t.r in(1) AND t.count_visit_pharma >0,t.cid,NULL)) rr
,SUM(count_visit) cvisit
,SUM(count_visit_pharma) cvisit_pharm

FROM tmp_pallitive_kancha t INNER JOIN  t_person_cid p ON t.cid=p.cid
INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode
WHERE p.NATION in(99) AND p.check_typearea IN(1,3)
GROUP BY h.hoscode
);

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("t1"+ "t3") AS target, SUM("r1"+ "r3") AS result, SUM("cvisit") AS cv, SUM("cvisit_pharm") AS rv, SUM("t1") AS "t1", SUM("r1") AS "r1", SUM("t2") AS "t2", SUM("r2") AS "r2", SUM("t3") AS "t3", SUM("r3") AS "r3", SUM("tc") AS "tc", SUM("rc") AS "rc", SUM("ti") AS "ti", SUM("ri") AS "ri", SUM("tf") AS "tf", SUM("rf") AS "rf", SUM("tn") AS "tn", SUM("rn") AS "rn", SUM("tj") AS "tj", SUM("rj") AS "rj", SUM("ti5") AS "ti5", SUM("ri5") AS "ri5", SUM("tr") AS "tr", SUM("rr") AS "rr"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
